title: A 26-layer folder processed with five Madar Automation Toolkit commands

headline.label: to run five commands over 26 layers

data: OpenStreetMap features (amenities, shops, roads, buildings, land use) in a 1.2 × 1.2 km box in east-central Riyadh (around Al Malaz), downloaded through the Overpass API on 2026-11-20 and split into 26 layers.
method: Split the extract into 26 layers in SHP, GPKG and GeoJSON, in EPSG 4326, 32638, 3857, 20438 and 9358, with one Shapefile missing its projection file as happens in real folders.
clip to an 450 m radius circle in the centre of the box.
convert to GeoPackage, then merge into one file, then area for an area and perimeter report.
limits: The layers are small (largest 425 features), so the times are dominated by start-up and do not represent files with millions of features. Each command was timed once on one machine. reproject ends with an error code when one file fails, and the layer without a coordinate system needs its system set by hand.
